currentLaunch.title: Meet five sixteenth patterns
currentLaunch.name: Early v2: Meet five sixteenth patterns
currentLaunch.focus: A short notation/response introduction: all five target one-beat patterns once each. Small pools and deliberate replay are appropriate here; twelve responses are unnecessary.
currentLaunch.summary: 5 rhythms · one beat · Standard counting · guide visible · 5 questions
currentLaunch.preparation: Divide one quarter-note beat into four equal positions: 1 e & a. Four sixteenth notes start at all four positions. A sixteenth rest, one sixteenth note, then an eighth rest starts only on e. An eighth rest, a sixteenth rest, then one sixteenth note starts only on a. Alternating sixteenth rests and notes start on e and a. A sixteenth rest, two sixteenth notes, then a sixteenth rest starts on e and &. Rests take time but have no note start. This fragment starts on beat 1; 2 in a wrong choice is a wrong beat number, not another beat here. Read supplied choices as note starts. Five questions introduce these five patterns once each; replay them deliberately if helpful, then try the separate supported bar application when ready.
